reviews.text: Hi Renildo Paixao, Thank you so much for your feedback! It's great to know you had a good experience with Cobasi! We always want to offer the best for the comfort of your pet and your home. Count on us for anything you need, okay? Sincerely, Cobasi Team.

Good variety of products, staff are attentive in guiding customers, but the bureaucratic part of the payment process could be faster; I believe that adjusting the system would improve it a lot. Even so, I recommend it!
Here I find everything I need to make my cats happy.

Hi Raphael Bloise, Thank you for your feedback. It's very important for us to know about our customers' experiences at our Cobasi stores. If you would like to add anything to your comment, please send a message to our email cac@cobasi.com.br or call/WhatsApp (11) 3831-8999 and we will promptly review it. We can improve by listening. Sincerely, Cobasi Team.

I would like to register my feedback regarding the Cobasi store located in the Guanabara supermarket.

Unfortunately, I had a very bad experience. I went to buy some fish for my children and expected to receive basic guidance on necessary care, such as feeding, aquarium acclimation, and water maintenance. However, I received practically no information.

I had to ask for help several times and practically beg for guidance. The staff showed great apathy, little willingness to help, and no interest in clarifying a customer's doubts.

Buying animals requires responsibility, and proper service makes all the difference in ensuring the well-being of the animals and customer satisfaction.

Unfortunately, this was a very disappointing experience. It was the first and certainly the last time I shop at this store. I hope the company reviews the training and conduct of its staff so that other customers do not go through the same situation.
Angelina, the saleswoman, was super friendly, congratulations!

Excellent service, however
I bought a 10kg bag of pet food and didn't get parking approval; Guanabara has this monopoly. So, it's better to have the product delivered to your home, it also avoids driving around in the crowded parking lot.

Cobasi could get this partnership for its customers, that's my suggestion.
Hi Juan Luc4s, Thank you for your feedback. Your feedback helps us further improve our customers' experience at Cobasi. We're always here for you! Until your next visit. Sincerely, The Cobasi Team.

This isn't the first time I've had a terrible experience with this store. I placed an order on their website and half an hour later I received an email saying that 3 out of the 5 items I ordered wouldn't be shipped. I requested an exchange for another brand, but they weren't helpful. I had to cancel the order, and the refund won't arrive for another 1 or 2 billing cycles, so it will take more than a month to get my money back.
Excellent

Hi Sirlenebarbosapereira Barbosa, Thank you so much for your feedback! It's great to know you had a good experience with Cobasi! We always want to offer the best for the comfort of your pet and your home. Count on us for anything you need, okay? Sincerely, Cobasi Team.

I went to buy my dogs' food, a 15kg bag, and asked to have the parking space waived. The attendant simply said she couldn't waive it because I had to do some grocery shopping... meaning, besides having already spent over 200, I still had to spend more at the supermarket... I'll never shop at that store again!

Very different from the Carrefour store where they waive parking!

Hi Jose Espinha Cardoso, Thank you so much for your feedback! It's great to know you had a good experience with Cobasi! We always want to offer the best for the comfort of your pet and your home. Count on us for anything you need, okay? Sincerely, Cobasi Team.
Do you sell tortoises?
Complete disregard for the customer! Outrageous!! The app schedules pet services for a store in Barra that doesn't provide that service.
Terrible service. Look for another location.

Hi Antonio Pasqualette, Thank you so much for your feedback! It's great to know you had a good experience with Cobasi! We always want to offer the best for the comfort of your pet and your home. Count on us for anything you need, okay? Sincerely, Cobasi Team.

I'm trying to contact them via WhatsApp; the message is seen, but there's no reply. They also don't answer calls on WhatsApp. I don't live in Brazil and I need medication for my dog ​​that isn't sold here, and I've had zero contact with the company. I tried buying it through the website, but they give a delivery time of 1 business day… difficult… because where it's supposed to be delivered, there's no one there all day to receive the package, unless you know more or less what time it will arrive. Negotiating with Cobasi is difficult. What a shame.
Easily accessible location, covered parking, fast service, clean and well-organized store.

Yesterday I went to that Cobasi store to buy grains to feed my pet bird. Everything I was looking for was unavailable – canary seed, millet, and oats. By the way, the canisters of the other grains were almost empty, which surprised me. There were also few options of packaged grains, which I don't usually buy for numerous reasons. My decision is that I will never return to that store...

It's annoying that you arrive before 10 PM and it's closed at 9:53 PM. I rushed to buy a spot for my cat, but they wouldn't open the door.

The delivery drivers aren't delivering to the address; they're leaving the food at the building's entrance instead of at the house's front door, which is absurd since it's at the entrance of the street and the house is 800 meters away from a 15 kg bag of pet food.
Great service!

They gave me pet food with larvae today, and tomorrow I'll have to go back to the store to resolve this problem. The employee even had the nerve to put the label on the tear where the pet food was. Terrible service.
